# kubernetes-mcp: Kubernetes & Minikube Orchestration Substrate
> FastMCP 3.4.4+ server with SOTA companion webapp. Allows dynamic cluster diagnostics (nodes, pods list/logs/describe, services, ingresses) and local Minikube control VM automation.

## Architecture
- **Backend (Port 10811)**: Python/FastAPI backend proxy.
- **Frontend (Port 10810)**: React/Vite companion dashboard (Zinc/Blue Dark theme).
- **Transport**: Stdio (Claude Desktop) and HTTP.

- [Primary Readme](README.md): Primary benefits and quick install JSON.

## Configuration
- [Pyproject](pyproject.toml): Python dependencies and build config.
- [Kubeconfig](~/.kube/config): Default Kubernetes credentials store location reference.
